description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Filter' within the OpenCart admin module, specifically in the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Extension.Opencart.Module'. The class extends a base controller and contains methods for managing the admin interface of a module called 'filter', including methods to display and save configuration settings.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'filter' module settings in the OpenCart admin interface. Extends the core Controller class and provides methods for displaying the configuration page ('index') and handling the save action ('save').

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the module configuration page in the admin panel, initializes language, title, breadcrumbs, loads header, column, footer, and renders the view with data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module's settings via AJAX, checks permissions, updates settings in the database, and returns a JSON response indicating success or errors.
